summary: Form 8-K filed by Global Business Travel Group, Inc. (Amex GBT) reporting shareholder litigation related to its pending acquisition by Long Lake Management Holdings Inc. under a May 2, 2026 Merger Agreement. Two state-court complaints (O'Toole and Lawrence) allege disclosure deficiencies in the definitive proxy statement, seeking injunctions and damages. The special meeting is set for August 3, 2026. The company denies wrongdoing but might consider supplemental disclosure to moot claims. No deal price, premium, or advisor is stated in this 8-K. Watch for potential preliminary injunction ruling or last-minute settlement before the vote.
